title: Ayodhya Bar Association seeks CBI probe into Ram Mandir funds mismanagement, says it won't defend accused
description: The Ayodhya Bar Association has passed a resolution demanding a Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) probe into the mishandling of public donations for the Ram Mandir, citing concerns over financial transparency and the alleged theft of temple offerings by the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust.The Association said that it is seeking a thorough investigation into the financial affairs and accounts of the Trust to ensure accountability.
